name: Shrimp Rice Bowl with Japanese-Style Carrot, Cucumber & Mango Salad (Two Ways)

ingredients.name: raw shrimp, peeled & deveined, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 mango
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 avocado

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, place mayo, vinegar, hot sauce, honey, and salt in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
½ tsp rice vinegar
½ tsp hot sauce
½ tsp honey
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and trim carrots; using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the carrots into noodle-like strips. Place 1 cup of carrot noodles on a plate, then add remaining carrot to the bowl with the dressing.

Trim cucumbers. Slice half of a cucumber crosswise into thin rounds and add to the plate with the carrot. Using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the remaining cucumber into noodle-like strips; add to the bowl.

Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Medium dice half of the mango, add to the plate, and set aside. Cut remaining mango lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces and add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl, along with bread crumbs and sesame seeds, then toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp panko bread crumbs
2 tsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 lb raw shrimp, peeled & deveined, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add 1 cup of shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until just opaque, 2-3 minutes. Add to the plate with the veggies. (Reserve skillet and remaining shrimp for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp neutral vegetable oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add remaining shrimp and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until just opaque, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp neutral vegetable oil
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp crushed red pepper
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice lengthwise into thin pieces.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide a ½-cup rice, reserved carrot noodles, cucumber slices, mango, plain shrimp, and half of the avocado between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining rice, salad, and spiced shrimp between plates or bowls. Top with remaining avocado and enjoy!
